proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated, defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks in init/comm structures. Enqueue needs review for substantive runtime behavior changes in strong-stream graph capture/mixing semantics and P2P scheduling limits. Device-topology needs review for substantive channel-count/peer-budget computation changes in topology path logic (including remote-peer channel defaults and maxP2pPeers-driven tuning).
